items.t: Chlorpromazine, oral, 75–300 mg at night, but may be increased to 800mg a day in 2–3 divided doses according to clinical response.

cautions.t: IM injection is painful and causes hypotension

adverse_effects.t: Sedation, postural hypotension, antimuscarinic effects, extrapyramidal effects, photosensitivity, QT prolongation
